description: This Java class implements a sliding window counter for monitoring metrics, allowing counting of success and failure measurements over configurable time windows and resolutions.

classes.name: SlidingWindowCounter
classes.description: A thread-safe implementation of a sliding window counter used to track success and failure metrics within specified time windows and resolutions.

methods.name: getLastSuccessMeasurementAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last success measurement.

methods.name: getLastFailureMeasurementAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last failure measurement.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the success counter using the current timestamp.
